thread:
Nora M: heads-up, saw a 120ms p99 on tiny requests during the 03:00 microburst. looks like reconcile hanging on full lanes added tail time
Diego P: where was the time spent? enqueue vs reconcile vs kernel?
Nora M: mostly enqueue wait. interestingly KV cache hits stayed high, so it's synchronization between the admission frontier and the reconciler
Sam V: could we just lower reconcile frequency? risk is more cross-lane interference and higher full-batch latency
Nora M: agreed. alternative idea: transient micro-lanes ephemeral admission pools for sub-64-token traffic that use a faster reconcile/evict path
Leah J: explain the difference vs current tiny-request fast-path?
Nora M: current fast-path is opportunistic within existing lanes; transient lanes are separate logical lanes with their own headroom accounting and `idle_release_ms` tuned very low
Diego P: nice. what about fragmentation on GPU side? smaller batches -> lower throughput per kernel invocation
Sam V: that is the tradeoff. we need heuristics that only route when throughput loss < X but latency win > Y
Leah J: propose heuristic: route to micro-lane if median_seq_len < 40 and recent batch_tokens_per_kernel < 256 and inter_arrival_p50 < 4ms
Nora M: and micro-lane config: base_headroom_tokens=512, max_batch_delay_ms=8, idle_release_ms=12
Leah J: sample config to test:
```
transient_microlane:
  enabled: true
  max_token_len: 64
  base_headroom_tokens: 512
  max_batch_delay_ms: 8
  idle_release_ms: 12
  backpressure_threshold: 0.9
  rollback_if:
    batching_eff_drop_pct: 7
    gpu_op_count_increase_pct: 4
```
infra-bot: perf snapshot: shard-3 microburst window: requests<64.tokens.p95_wait_ms=92, reconcile_latency_ms.p95=46, kernel_invocations_per_sec.delta=+3%
Diego P: rollback triggers look sane. add a guard to avoid flip-flopping: require 3 consecutive windows before enabling microlane on a shard
Sam V: i'll run the synthetic microburst harness (10k req/s, varying token lengths) and measure tokens-per-kernel and tail latency
Nora M: plan: local sim -> single-shard canary (2%) -> 10% if metrics good. targets: p99 for <64 tokens down by >=30ms and batching_efficiency drop <6%
Leah J: also add telemetry: per-lane headroom utilization, microlane_batch_size_hist, reconcile_invocation_reason tag
Diego P: minor: ensure admission accounting charges correctly so billing and tenant fairness unaffected
Nora M: agreed. i'll own the canary ticket and the rollout playbook
Sam V: i'll post harness results and a perf dashboard link. will include an automated revert run for the canary
infra-bot: note: create rollout INF-1917 and add postmortem playbook template.
